title: Analyze Slide Media Size (AlignAndSize)

scenarios.title: Analyze Slide Media Size applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Analyze Slide Media Size (BtnSlideSize) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Slide Size selection scope matches its metadata contract
scenarios.expected: Slide Size (BtnSlideSize, MinSelection=0, RequiredType=None declared explicitly in SlideSizeFeature.cs - the catalog reader does not default it, so the shape-only branch of the contract does not apply to this feature) is enabled for an empty selection and for a single selected shape, because it declares no minimum. The scenario asserts that the feature's declared [FeatureMetadata] scope drives the production sidebar enablement decision consistently (metadata -> SidebarStateEvaluator, the declared minimum reachable as an enabled button). It does not execute or inspect the command's own selection guard: an enabled command can still refuse a selection, which is why the guard and the PowerPoint effect stay owned by the office-automated leg.
